title: Classes
summary: A blueprint for making objects — and the shape of every Angular component.
heading: Classes

blocks.text: A class is a blueprint for making objects. You describe what data it holds and what it can do once, then create as many objects from it as you like with new.

blocks.caption: One class (blueprint) can create many objects.

blocks.text: An Angular component is just a TypeScript class with a @Component label on top. Everything you learn here applies directly.

items: A class is a blueprint; new builds an object from it.
The constructor sets up the object's data.
Methods are the things the object can do.
Angular components are classes — so you already know the shape.
